title: FERPA routing: student_record calls served by cloud
notes: student_record is local-only by policy (src/lib/ai/provider.ts, .claude/rules/sage-ai.md) but the provider fails OPEN to cloud when the local host is unavailable (VQ-R-002/003, still an open FERPA ruling in .claude/MEMORY.md) — so this ratio is expected to read 1.0 today, since no local AI host is live in prod yet. The floor is therefore 0 ONLY when env BENCH_FERPA_LOCAL_EXPECTED=1 (set once a local host is actually deployed and load-bearing); otherwise this metric is info, and the result carries a header note saying why. Reuses buildProviderMix() from scripts/sage-ai-accountability.mjs, connected via BENCH_PROD_READONLY_URL over the trailing 30 days of AuditLog(targetType="ai_request").
